correctness.rationale: For sigma>0,kappa>epsilon>0, unique equilibrium (-r/sigma,0,0) follows from q=y+iz satisfying qdot=(phi(x)-1+ix)q. Eigenvalues -sigma, phi(-r/sigma)-1 +-i(-r/sigma) cross at |r|=sigma/sqrt(delta), delta=kappa-epsilon. Positive crossing derivative 2delta^{3/2}/(kappa*sigma). At positive threshold, center manifold u=a q+conj(a q)+O(|q|^2), a=sigma/[2(sigma+i omega)], omega=-1/sqrt(delta), with h11=-2c|a|^2/sigma, c=-2delta^{3/2}/kappa and d=delta^2(kappa-4epsilon)/kappa^2. Quadratic elimination gives resonant real cubic nu=|a|^2(2d-2c^2/sigma-2c/omega) = -sigma delta^3[sigma(kappa+4epsilon)+4delta]/[2kappa^2(1+sigma^2delta)]<0. Independent symbolic simplification confirmed generic identity, normal form and signs; Hopf theorem gives unique nearby attracting limit cycle for |r|>rH, amplitude asymptotics and period 2pi sqrt(delta). Sign conjugacy maps +/- r thresholds. No global orbit assertion.
